timer_seconds 72000 (D57): the PICKUP's gate, not Brighteyes's: quest row TuskRampagerPickUp (id 5063) min_Delta 72000 s = 20 h, max_Solves -1; ACE refuses to pick this tusk from a corpse that is not the player's own while the quest cannot be solved again (Player_Inventory.cs:1249-1262; HandleSolveError QuestManager.cs:558-578), so one Rampager Tusk per 20 hours; a completion is recorded at the turn-in, so the next due time is never early
level: min 60 and max null are the ground tusker-holding's entry portal 22680 MinLevel 60 and MaxLevel (none) (weenie_properties_int types 86 and 87; the profile's entry block)
experience: fixed 8,000,000 (the AwardXP amount_64 of emote 48433), not level-proportional

hunt-until: the carrier 22599 Rampager is on the tusker-holding profile's targets; the item is the tusk 22429 (one per kill, a guaranteed Contain row); the step's count 1 is checked before the hunt, so a tusk already held skips it (the autopilot's errand runs this same file)

The Aphus Lassel Portal Gem 22729 that Brighteyes gives is the rung change's fallback (item 4's travel file gems, 'aphus-lassel': spell 2936 'Entrance to Tusker Island', arriving at the Refuge 0xF6820033): the turn-in's reward is also the way back to the Refuge, and item 4's travel file names this item as its source

timer_from pickup (M6 audit, 2026-11-19): ACE stamps the tusk's own Quest string when it is picked up from a corpse, not at the turn-in: VerifyQuest (Player_Inventory.cs:1249-1262 @95ef426d) passes CanSolve and sets questSolve, then the pickup runs EmoteManager.OnQuest (:1093-1094), which adds or stamps the quest (EmoteManager.cs:2021-2041); the giver stamps nothing. So the 20 h run from the pickup: the client counts them from the moment the tusk is first seen in the pack (never before the pickup, so never early), and from the turn-in when that moment is not known (a new session)
